name: Cleanup failure while an exception is pending

input.source_text: let mut n = 0; class It { public fun next() { n = n + 1; if n < 2 { Iteration.yield(1) } else { Iteration.done } } public fun close() { raise :cleanup } } class Src { public fun iterator() { It.new() } } try { for x in Src.new() { raise :primary } } catch e: Symbol, c { [e, c.suppressed] }
